title: NOT appropriate for girls
text: I ordered this for my 10 yr daughter and and after having her try it on I was very disappointed with how small the crotch and butt area of the suit was. The picture shows how narrow the bottom of the suit is and the back of the suit was also very narrow and high to give a “cheeky” look to the butt. And this is with me ordering a size 12. I  returning the suit and have ordered an age appointment suit from Target.
